title: 소프트 에러 · Soft Error
brief: Show the Soft submode of the Hard / Soft Error mechanism, with 'Soft' visibly selected in the compact submode switch. Compare two intact 1T1C DRAM cells storing 1. A transient particle event perturbs the vulnerable storage node and changes its readout without a permanent broken wire. The normal cell retains data. A correct rewrite restores the soft-upset cell. Plot the injected transient and the normal/fault stored charge on a synchronized timeline. Phases: 데이터 저장 / 입자 사건 / 데이터 변화 / 재기록 복구. Mitigation control 'ECC·Scrub 적용' corrects a correctable read result then rewrites it; distinguish corrected DOUT from the still-upset physical cell until rewrite.
